scope: Original frozen code and saved artifacts for 003 through 006R; targeted forensic software tests, not a new scientific inference experiment.
acceptance_subclaim_to_withdraw: Within-family slice exploration accepted as an adequate sampler; freezing this conditional sampler for FAMILY_EVIDENCE_BRIDGE_007.

findings.classification: source-level probability-measure defect plus exact archived initial-draw replay
findings.title: Clipped proposal draws do not have the continuous density used to score them
findings.scope_limit: Family-0 initial draws only, not every family or terminal particle. Clipping frequency is not a measured final posterior-bias magnitude.

findings.classification: source defect with deterministic uniform-target stationarity counterexample
findings.title: Initial slice bracket is repositioned by clipping its left endpoint before constructing its right endpoint

original_transition_reduction_check.note: Exact original transition versus algebraic uniform-target reduction; two direction signs, default max_steps_out=8.

findings.scope_limit: Corrected-bracket control is an isolated forensic test, not a fully repaired or qualified sampler.

findings.title: Arithmetic and integrity checks were mistaken for distributional correctness checks
findings.detail: Constant-likelihood test checks finite evidence, in-cube particles, uniqueness and normalized weights, not exact normalization or invariant-distribution moments. Mutation proposals were not independently replayed; writer hooks were not enabled by the production caller.

findings.title: Low posterior-mean error and an exact-family-weight oracle did not establish adequate conditional posterior sampling
findings.detail: Primary R1 95% coverage includes 55/64 and 56/64; the registered coverage gate fails. Exact family weights do not verify within-family tails, covariance or invariance.

findings.title: Lower error was not an equal-compute result
findings.detail: 128-particle slice R1 consumes 4.40894 times all likelihood evaluations and 11.96587 times native evaluations relative to the parent. Counts are not direct wall-time ratios.

findings.title: Family discrimination in the 8D and 16D reference benchmark depends only on its first 2D block
findings.detail: Useful for sampler testing, but not a coupled high-dimensional physical family-identification validation. Family-independent nuisance evidence factors should be used as a cancellation/control diagnostic.

findings.classification: physical-claim scope limitation, not a new invalidation of the canary
findings.title: 003 is an eight-observation, four-cluster matched-family canary, not population-level movie recovery or marginalization advantage
findings.detail: Three double-hotspot and one single-hotspot backgrounds; no flare-drift truth. Differential active frame counts 4,2,7,3. The registered inactive-frame rule remains legitimate. Single-best joint fit also passes and has lower aggregate mean error than the weighted mean.

findings.title: Compact canonical records do not equal full remote source/results deposition; percentage-complete estimates lacked a defined basis
findings.detail: 006R checked GitHub directory has a canonical JSON, short RESULTS and NEXT_STAGE only. Exact source and banks exist in the hash-matching ZIP. Original R2 provenance remains unresolved. Withdraw percentage-complete estimates without replacing them.

preserved_conclusions: 006R completed and failed; descriptive metrics remain results of the as-coded program.
006 remains incomplete with no promoted subset.
KNOT_QUADRATURE_002 finite-panel numerical pass is not invalidated by these sampler defects.
003 point-reconstruction canary is not retroactively invalidated by bugs in the later slice implementation; its original uncertainty failure and scope limits remain.
No conclusion that the physical movie-recovery hypothesis is false follows from the sampler defects.
next_action: Correct and independently test the proposal measure and mutation invariance before freezing a conditional sampler or executing evidence-only 007; then use fresh coupled calibration targets and matched-cost controls, followed by a separately registered physical calibration.
causal_limit: This audit does not quantify how much each defect contributed to the original 006R family-evidence or coverage errors; a controlled corrected rerun is needed.
